description: This file defines the 'GenericEntityException' class, which extends 'GeneralException' and represents exceptions specific to entity operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes various constructors for creating exception instances with different levels of detail.

classes.name: GenericEntityException
classes.description: Custom exception class for entity-related errors in the OFBiz framework, extending the GeneralException class.

methods.name: GenericEntityException()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating a GenericEntityException without any message or cause.

methods.name: GenericEntityException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a Throwable cause to be wrapped by this exception.

methods.name: GenericEntityException(String str)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a string message describing the exception.

methods.name: GenericEntityException(String str, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts both a message and a cause for the exception.
